cross_variant_comparability_caveat: R2/MSE/MAE/PHM08 are only directly comparable WITHIN a cap regime (A vs A, B vs B, C vs C). Comparing across variants (e.g. A vs C) conflates model quality with a change in the RUL target's scale/skew caused by capping. Variant A and B rows are numerically identical here because this ablation only reads each variant's train.csv, and A/B share the same (capped) train-side RUL -- their only difference is test-side capping, which this train-only nested-CV ablation never sees.
